evidence.summary: Each run returns polled, failed, skipped_backoff, skipped_paused, paused_sites, stopped_reason, duration_seconds to the Celery result backend (read back for both runs) and logs it; refusals log a warning with site, status, hours and until; observations carry parse_flags.status_transition and parse_flags.site_paused; status.json env shows what the worker was given.

rationale: Enough to diagnose U1 from the result backend and cip. Limits: no alert or UI chip for a paused site yet (design puts it in U6); worker log not read in this run (outside the declared roots).
